cathedral.name: San Salvador Cathedral
cathedral.hours: Daily roughly 08:00–17:00 · check on the day
cathedral.tip: Oscar Romero is buried in the crypt. Dress modestly and keep quiet during mass.

monument.name: Monument to the Divine Savior of the World
monument.landmark: Monument to the Divine Savior of the World
monument.tip: It sits in a busy roundabout. View it from the plaza side and watch the traffic.

rosario.name: Iglesia El Rosario
rosario.hours: Daily roughly 08:00–18:00 · check on the day
rosario.tip: Come inside for the rainbow light through the stained-glass walls. Best on a sunny day.

joya.name: Joya de Cerén
joya.price_text: Small entry fee · check on the day
joya.tip: It is a UNESCO Maya village site about an hour west of the city. Go early and bring sun protection.

pupusa.name: Pupusa
pupusa.tip: Order revueltas with curtido and salsa. Eat them hot at a busy stand.

mercado-ex.name: Mercado Ex-Cuartel craft market
mercado-ex.price_text: Free to enter · pay per item
mercado-ex.tip: Good for crafts and souvenirs. Keep bags close and agree prices first.

plaza-libertad.name: Plaza Libertad and National Palace walk
plaza-libertad.price_text: Free · palace entry may be small fee
plaza-libertad.hours: Plaza always open · palace hours vary
plaza-libertad.tip: Walk the plaza and peek at the National Palace facade. Go in daylight and stay on busy streets.

el-boqueron.name: El Boquerón volcano viewpoint
el-boqueron.price_text: Small entry fee · check on the day
el-boqueron.tip: Cool air and a crater view above the city. Bring a jacket and go on a clear morning.

devil-gate.name: Puerta del Diablo viewpoint
devil-gate.tip: Rock viewpoint with valley views south of the city. Go with a guide or taxi and avoid late afternoon.

zona-rosa-walk.name: Zona Rosa evening walk
zona-rosa-walk.tip: Restaurants and bars line the streets here. Walk the main blocks and take taxis between areas.

escalon-food.name: Colonia Escalón food street
escalon-food.tip: Try a local comedor for lunch. Prices are lower at midday.

city-tour.name: Centro Histórico guided walking tour
city-tour.price_text: ≈ USD 15–40 per person · check on the day
city-tour.tip: A local guide explains the cathedral, plaza and market safely. Book ahead and confirm the meeting point.

san-benito.name: Colonia San Benito stroll
san-benito.tip: Leafy streets with embassies, cafés and museums. Good for a relaxed afternoon walk.

art-museum.name: MARTE contemporary art museum
art-museum.price_text: Small entry fee · check on the day
art-museum.tip: Small modern art museum in San Benito. Check current exhibitions before you go.

national-museum.name: National Museum of Anthropology (MUNA)
national-museum.price_text: Small entry fee · check on the day
national-museum.tip: Covers El Salvador's history from Maya times. A good rainy-day stop.

coffee-tour.name: Coffee farm tour outside the city
coffee-tour.price_text: ≈ USD 25–50 per person · check on the day
coffee-tour.tip: El Salvador grows good coffee. Book a half-day farm visit and taste at the source.

pupuseria-evening.name: Evening pupusería dinner
pupuseria-evening.tip: Pupuserías get busy after dark. Try cheese-and-bean and loroco fillings.

volcano-hike.name: San Salvador volcano hike
volcano-hike.price_text: Guide ≈ USD 20–40 · check on the day
volcano-hike.tip: Go with a guide and start early before clouds arrive. Wear sturdy shoes.

nightlife-zona.name: Zona Rosa nightlife
nightlife-zona.tip: Bars and live music cluster here. Use a taxi or rideshare at night.
